newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville power offers unchanged for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville power offers unchanged for Thursday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left offers for next-day surplus power unchanged for Thursday, the federal power marketing agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued to offer 200 megawatts of firm peak power at $11.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest and $12.00 for Oregon border sales.
BPA also continued to refrain from offering non-firm power during morning and evening peaks on Thursday.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm shoulder hour (0600-0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2300) offers were also steady at $10.00 for Northwest and $11.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) and Nevada-Oregon border (NOB) sales.
BPA also offered displacement power during off-peak hours on Thursday at $7.00 per MWh for all deliveries and at $5.00 for Northwest buyers only.
